text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen for four periods in a row, so I should review whether my holdings and risk level still fit my ten-year goal rather than assume the decline will reverse.","I made no trades, but that alone did not protect my account; I should make deliberate decisions based on a clear plan, not trade just to feel active.","I should avoid reacting to short-term losses with panic, and keep contributing only at a pace I can afford while maintaining a diversified portfolio."]}
